description: A discrete-time deterministic SEIR-type model to describe influenza transmission dynamics, where the population is divided into Susceptible (S), Exposed (E), Infectious (I), and Removed (R) compartments. The Exposed and Infectious compartments are further divided into two sub-compartments each (E1, E2 and I1, I2). The model links the transmission dynamics to data on severe influenza cases (ICU/HDU admissions) through an observational model.
